dialect.detail: OpenEZA / Open Source EZASOKET project - a GnuCOBOL implementation of IBM TCP/IP socket API (EZASOKET). Uses COPY books from the OpenEZA library.
evidence: OpenEZA comment block with GPL v3 license

purpose.domain_detail: TCP/IP socket programming test harness using EZASOKET API; implements a listener/server using SELECTEX for single-process concurrency
purpose.summary: This program implements a TCP socket listener (server) using the OpenEZA EZASOKET interface. It binds to port 5015, listens for connections, uses SELECTEX for non-blocking I/O multiplexing, accepts a connection, receives data, and validates that the received data matches the expected string 'TEST SEND FROM SEND0015'. It is a test counterpart to send0015.cbl.

notable_features: CALL 'EZASOKET' with SELECTEX function for socket I/O multiplexing
BY VALUE pointer argument (ECBLIST-PTR) in CALL statement
Multiple COPY books for socket API sections (INITAPI, SOCKET, BIND, LISTEN, ACCEPT, etc.)
Inline IF/ELSE with END-IF (COBOL-85 scope terminators)
GPL v3 license header in comments
verdict.notes: Program-ID is LISTEN10 but filename is listen15.cbl and the program references port 5015 and 'LISTEN15' string - minor inconsistency suggesting iterative development. The copy_count of 12 means most logic is in copybooks not visible here.
